name: Osimertinib
mechanism: Irreversible EGFR TKI that forms a covalent bond with cysteine 797 in the ATP-binding site. It is selective for EGFR-sensitising and T790M-resistant mutants while relatively sparing wild-type EGFR, and achieves meaningful CNS penetration.
monitoring: ECG and electrolytes at baseline and periodically, particularly with QT-prolonging drugs
Echocardiographic LVEF assessment in patients with cardiac risk factors
Prompt evaluation of new respiratory symptoms for ILD
interactions: Avoid strong CYP3A4 inducers, which reduce exposure. Caution with other QT-prolonging medicines.
resistance: On-target C797S/C797G and other tertiary EGFR mutations; MET or HER2 amplification; acquired RET, ALK or BRAF fusions; KRAS/BRAF/PIK3CA mutations; transformation to small-cell or squamous histology.
